data_description.debug_log_component: Turns on debug-level logging for this integration.
data_description.log_missed_base64: When enabled, missed/invalid payloads are logged in Base64 for diagnostics.
data_description.log_obis: When enabled, parsed OBIS codes are included in the logs.
data_description.save_raw_data: Starts a local capture after a STATUS message and at least four other MQTT messages, then saves up to 100 MQTT messages total, including STATUS. A synthetic device ID replaces the original in STATUS and topics. Sensitive STATUS and readable OBIS fields are redacted, but opaque payloads are unchanged and may contain identifying information. Review captures before sharing.

confirm.title: Finish unsupported meter capture
confirm.description:
More than half of the received messages from {device} could not be decoded. Raw capture was therefore enabled automatically and diagnostic data is now being collected.

You can help add support for this meter by creating a GitHub issue and attaching the raw capture file. Submitted captures are used to improve meter support and are added to the automated test suite to help prevent future regressions.

Please allow the capture file to collect data for a while before downloading it.

Note: If the download does not start when clicking the link, right-click the link and choose "Save link as..." or "Open link in new tab".

[Download raw capture]({download_url}) | [Documentation]({documentation_url}) | [Create GitHub issue]({issue_url})

Before continuing, make sure you have downloaded the latest raw capture and created a GitHub issue.

When you confirm, capture collection will stop and the local capture file will be permanently deleted.

confirm.title: Finish meter capture
confirm.description:

Note: If the download does not start when clicking the link, right-click the link and choose "Save link as..." or "Open link in new tab".

{download_url} | {documentation_url} | {issue_url}

Before continuing, make sure you have downloaded the latest raw capture and created a GitHub issue.

When you confirm, capture collection will stop and the local capture file will be permanently deleted.
